name: Lo-Ruhama (Hosea's daughter)
title: Symbol of God's judgment on Israel
summary: Lo-Ruhama was the daughter of the prophet Hosea and his wife Gomer. Her name, meaning 'not loved' or 'without mercy,' served as a prophetic sign that God would temporarily withhold His mercy from the northern kingdom of Israel due to their apostasy and idolatry.

keyEvents.title: Birth as a Prophetic Sign
keyEvents.description: Lo-Ruhama was born as Hosea's second child, and God commanded that she be given this name as a sign that He would no longer show mercy to the house of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Judgment on Israel, but Not Judah
keyEvents.description: Through Lo-Ruhama's name, God declared that He would remove Israel, yet at the same time show mercy to Judah and save them by the Lord their God.

keyEvents.title: Promise of Restoration
keyEvents.description: Despite the message of judgment, God gave a promise of future restoration where 'Lo-Ruhama' would become 'Ruhama' - from 'not loved' to 'loved.'

keyEvents.title: Fulfillment in the New Covenant People
keyEvents.description: The apostle Peter quotes the prophecy of Hosea and applies it to the Gentile Christians who have now received mercy and become God's people.
